name: Didga
origin: Tweed Heads, New South Wales, Australia
bio: Rescued from a shelter and trained by animal trainer Robert Dollwet (CATMANTOO), Didga is the world's most accomplished feline athlete: she skateboards down Australian boardwalks, ollies over dogs, and holds the Guinness World Record for the most tricks performed by a cat in one minute. Tony Hawk remains unavailable for comment.
awards: Guinness World Record: most tricks performed by a cat in one minute (2016)
